evidence.title: Historical JSONL corruption outside 100000-row retention horizon still aborts run_once before refreshing scoring, handoff and evidence health
evidence.proof_level: Exact-SHA source/test inspection and deterministic test oracle only; NOT a full-repository run, measured incident or benchmark
exact_chain: storage.py load_observations(path,max_records) iterates all physical lines, json.loads and FlowObservation.from_dict occur before deque retention; malformed old line raises ValueError with source path and line number even if older than max_records=100000.

storage.py append_observations invokes load_observations(max_records=100000) before duplicate filtering, including when collected list is empty; a malformed archive line therefore blocks a no-network/no-input scan.

runner.py run_once calls append_observations, then load_observations again, then scoring/handoff/evidence_health and three atomic_write_json outputs. Archive exceptions are not caught or converted to source_errors/collection_attempts.

Result: after one successful run, a later archive parse error can leave latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json from the previous run in place, with no new run health artifact. This is a failure-mode possibility; downstream consumers' behavior was not audited.

Current test_providers_replay.py checks valid bounded-tail loads and same-ID dedup, while test_evidence_health.py checks empty no-network run; inspected tests do not exercise malformed historical line beyond retention.
evidence.distinct_from_C: Archive loading/admission and reporting failure occurs before C's normalization/handoff equal-rank or future-effective PIT issue.

deterministic_full_repo_regression.setup: In a TemporaryDirectory create a valid JSONL archive of 3 FlowObservation.to_dict rows, insert malformed line as first physical line, set load_observations(max_records=2); verify exact ValueError includes path and line 1. For run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=[],local_dir=tmp,as_of_ms=T), first generate valid latest/audit/handoff artifacts, then corrupt historical line and rerun; assert explicit exception and compare artifact hashes/mtimes. Instrument load_observations to count all parsed lines. Repeat with a valid row and same-ID metadata conflict in both input orders and sequential calls, identical duplicate, old-ID replay with max_existing_records=2, PIT and evidence_health.
deterministic_full_repo_regression.expected_current_behavior: Malformed older line raises despite bounded deque; run_once raises before writing refreshed output artifacts. Full repository test has not executed; these are predictions from source.
deterministic_full_repo_regression.desired_repair_criteria: Fail closed without silently skipping or backdating corrupt history; produce explicit durable archive-integrity failure diagnostic and prevent stale outputs being mistaken for fresh. Preserve append-only PIT, exact duplicates, provenance and quality metadata; regression both permutations and sequential runs.
